caption: "The Skeld" — a 22-room floor plan, 2546 m² total: Reactor (139 m²), Upper Engine (143 m²), Lower Engine (182 m²), Reactor Hall (84 m²), Security (56 m²), Upper Hall (120 m²), MedBay (91 m²), Cafeteria (360 m²), and 14 more; 21 doors, 3 windows.
accDescr: A single-deck spaceship plan, 90 by 40 metres. Reactor at the bow on the left, Navigation at the pointed stern on the right, engine rooms top-left and bottom-left, and a large Cafeteria across the top of midship.
